# CodeBuild

Persist regional build-project configuration and tags without starting builds or provisioning workers.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `codebuild` |
| Signing name | `codebuild` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2016-10-06` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 5 of 59 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#codebuild) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No StartBuild, build history/status, batch builds, workers, image pulls, source checkout, artifact publication, logs, webhook execution, report groups or report generation.
- No credential import/authentication API or stored source tokens, IAM/KMS evaluation, secret resolution or network provisioning. EncryptionKey is excluded; no fabricated default encryption key, badge, URL or runtime identifier.
- Source authentication, webhook/status reporting, Git submodules/SSL flags, secondary sources/artifacts, cache, VPC, logs, filesystems, Docker server, fleets, registry credentials and advanced settings fail explicitly even false/null/empty.
- Finite local validation restricts Git provider URLs, bucket/key references, Docker image format and environment variable names/count/value lengths. References are configuration only; bucket/role/image/secret existence and access are not checked.
- Update/Delete require names; BatchGetProjects alone accepts project ARNs. Cross-scope ARNs are reported in projectsNotFound; shared project access is absent. Duplicate request identifiers collapse in first-input order.
- Nested source/artifact/environment objects supplied to UpdateProject replace that configuration with create-style defaults. Omitted top-level members retain their previous values. A successful compensating CloudFormation update advances LastModified while preserving Created/Arn.
- No dedicated mutation console. The [records guide](../guides/codebuild-records.md) lists every selected member, nested boundary, default, tag/reference/update rule and executable lifecycle.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
